abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate the association between serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) half-life (HL) and prognosis in prepubertal children with elevated AFP values 3 to 4 weeks after surgery for testicular yolk sac tumors (YST). METHODS: Prepubertal patients with testicular YST treated with radical orchiectomy between January 2016 and December 2022 were retrospectively reviewed. Negative outcomes were defined as relapse, metastasis or death. Univariate and multivariate logistic regression analyses were conducted to select risk factors for negative outcomes. RESULTS: A total of 42 patients were eventually enrolled into the study. Patients were divided into non-negative and negative outcomes groups, consisting of 35 and 7 patients, respectively. Thirty-five patients were stage I, two cases were stage II, and five cases were stage IV, according to the Children's Oncology Group staging system. The overall survival (OS) rate was 100%. Average AFP values significantly decreased after resection (P < 0.001). A significant positive correlation was shown between pre- and postoperative AFP values (r = 0.60, P < 0.001). Long AFP HL was considered as an independent risk factor for negative outcomes in YST patients underwent radical orchiectomy (P = 0.04). The cut-off value for AFP HL was 5.78 days, regardless of age division. CONCLUSION: Testicular YST is a relatively rare disease in children with an OS of 100%, and salvage chemotherapy is effective even in grade IV patients. The postoperative AFP HL was significantly associated with prognosis in prepubertal patients with testicular YST. The cut-off value for AFP HL is 5.78 days regardless of the effect of physiological AFP elevation.
abstract_ja: 目的:思春期前児における根治的精巣摘除術後3〜4週間の上昇したαフェトプロテイン(AFP)値と予後の関連性を評価すること。方法:2016年1月から2022年12月に精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍に対して根治的精巣摘除術で治療された思春期前患者を後方視的に検討した。負の転帰は再発、転移、または死亡と定義された。単変量および多変量ロジスティック回帰分析を実施して、負の転帰の危険因子を選別した。結果:最終的に42例の患者が本研究に組み入れられた。患者は非負転帰群(35例)および負転帰群(7例)に分けられた。35例は病期I、2例は病期II、5例は病期IVであった(小児腫瘍学グループ病期分類による)。全生存期間(全生存率)は100%であった。平均αフェトプロテイン(AFP)値は切除後に有意に低下した(P<0.001)。術前および術後のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)値間に有意な正の相関が認められた(r=0.60、P<0.001)。長いαフェトプロテイン(AFP)半減期は根治的精巣摘除術を受けた卵黄嚢腫瘍患者における負の転帰の独立危険因子と考えられた(P=0.04)。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)半減期のカットオフ値は5.78日であり、年齢分類に関わらずであった。結論:精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍は小児における比較的稀な疾患であり、全生存期間(全生存率)は100%であり、救援化学療法は病期IVの患者でも有効である。術後αフェトプロテイン(AFP)半減期は思春期前の精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍患者の予後と有意に関連していた。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)半減期のカットオフ値は生理的αフェトプロテイン(AFP)上昇の影響に関わらず5.78日である。
